title: Count-controlled iteration: the for loop
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Lap counter
objectives: know how to write a for loop that repeats a block a set number of times
understand how range() decides which values the loop counter takes
know how to build a running total inside a loop, and how to put one loop inside another
